latestVersion.changelog:
Updated to work with the Openclaw Projects and Build a dev team skills more cohesively   |   https://clawhub.ai/encryptshawn/openclaw-projects   |  https://clawhub.ai/encryptshawn/build-dev-team
- Expanded agent workspace requirements: now references HEARTBEAT.md and AGENTS.md in addition to USER.md and TOOLS.md, specifying their contents and operational roles.
- Added structured format and strict rules for HEARTBEAT.md to guide queue checking, including model selection, minimal reasoning, and multi-project participation.
- Introduced protocols for ClickUp task management as an alternative to Asana, using the same heartbeat structure.
- Clarified that heartbeat runs must always use the cheapest available model, explicitly disallowing fallback to primary models to conserve resources.
- Defined clear failure-handling behavior for heartbeat sessions: fail cheap, log, and never escalate or retry with higher-cost models.
